concerns.text: Spec US1 requires collecting demographic data (Age, Education) and exporting to CSV. Tasks T022d (Render Form), T022e (Capture Data), and T022g_logic (CSV export) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). Without these, the core data collection flow for US1 is missing, preventing the implementation of the survey and data export required by the spec.

Spec US1 requires participants to rate *each* stimulus. Task T019 (Implement validation logic to block submission if < 4 stimuli rated) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). Missing this validation allows incomplete data collection, violating the spec's requirement for complete within-subjects data.

concerns.text: Spec US2 requires a full statistical analysis pipeline (Preprocess, ANOVA, Pairwise tests, Effect sizes, Power analysis). All corresponding tasks (T024a_b through T048) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The entire US2 implementation is missing.
Spec US3 requires Mixed-Effects models with covariates and robustness checks. Tasks T032_33_35 and T049 are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). The implementation for US3 is missing.

Revision tasks T051 (Effect Size CI), T052 (Model Convergence), and T053 (Session Integrity Audit) are marked `[ ]` (incomplete). These address specific reviewer concerns raised in prior stages; their absence means the plan does not fully resolve known issues.

Spec US1 implies a need for session integrity (handling timeouts/incomplete sessions). Task T023f_heartbeat (Implement session timeout detection) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). While T053 covers post-hoc audit, the real-time session handling task is missing.

Task T043a (Generate Mock Data) is marked `[X]` (complete) but the description says 'Create a script... to generate'. If the script is created but not executed, the mock data file `data/raw/submissions.csv` does not exist, blocking downstream tasks. The task status should reflect whether the *file* exists or just the *script*.

Task T016b (Implement balanced Latin Square selection) is marked `[ ]` (incomplete). However, T028e (Define Latin Square sequences) is marked `[X]`. The selection logic is critical for US1. The task is present but incomplete, contributing to the US1 blockage.
